name: r10-bulk1d-ring-stel
author: solx-loop
description: Exploration of explore:bulk-pipeline. Hypothesis: a 1-D TMA ring (cp.async.bulk + mbarrier) moves bytes with fewer SM instructions, which the portal's 1500 MHz SM clock should reward. Refuted on the rented B200. The TMA bulk-store path is about 27% slower than STG.256 for a write-only stream. Bulk loads are about 3% slower than LDG.256 at 805 MB and add about 0.3-0.4 us of fixed cost. A persistent ring also adds about 0.8 us of per-CTA serialisation at small sizes. The best variant uses bulk loa
